column2: its owner doesn’t shuffle their library
column3: Outdated (conclusion B): this 2009-05-01 clause applied the old rule (CR 701.15c/701.16c, "that library is not shuffled"), reversed by the Magic Origins Comprehensive Rules update (Wizards bulletin by Matt Tabak, 2015-07-16; effective with Magic Origins, 2015-07-17): under current CR 701.24c the library is shuffled even though the creature stays where it is (interpretation self-shuffle-gone-library-still-shuffled, provisional); the rest of the ruling ("Blitz Hellion stays wherever it is") is tested in tests/rulings/r_p180_tuck.rs
